description: Company research and vendor due diligence: send a company name and official website, get a sourced profile (summary, official-site facts, public contact emails, recent mentions, evidence score, sources, limitations) for company lookup, supplier checks and KYB pre-screens from public web evidence. Not legal identity, credit or registry data. Paid: $0.023 USDC per call via x402 on Base. Calling without payment returns the payment requirement; invalid input is not charged.

objective.description: Optional research question, e.g. Is this a legitimate supplier of industrial pumps?
